items.title: Self-compassion break
items.teaser: A three-step pause for hard moments: notice it is hard, remember you are not alone, offer yourself some kindness.

content.short: Notice it is hard, remember you are not alone, be kind to yourself.
content.intro: Recovery has hard days. A self-compassion break is a short pause where you treat yourself the way you would treat a friend who is struggling. It is not about pretending things are fine. If you feel unsafe, use Get help now.

steps.title: Notice it is hard
steps.text: Name what is happening, quietly or in your head: "This is a hard moment." or "This hurts." You do not need to fix it yet.

steps.title: You are not alone
steps.text: Remind yourself: "Other people feel this too. Struggling is part of being human, and part of recovery."

steps.title: Offer some kindness
steps.text: Put a hand on your chest or another spot that feels comforting. Ask: "What would I say to a friend right now?" Say that to yourself.

steps.title: One kind next step
steps.text: Choose one small, kind thing for the next hour: water, food, rest, a message to someone, a meeting.

items.title: First 30 days: a guided journal series
items.teaser: A short daily series for early recovery: what you are noticing, what helps, and who is in your corner.

prompts.title: Day 1: Why now
prompts.text: What made you want to start this, today? Write it in your own words.

prompts.title: Day 2: What a good day looks like
prompts.text: Describe a simple, ordinary good day in recovery. What is in it?

prompts.title: Day 3: People in my corner
prompts.text: Who could you reach out to on a hard day? What would you say to them?

prompts.title: Day 4: My early warning signs
prompts.text: What do you notice in your thoughts, body or routine before things get hard?

prompts.title: Day 5: What helped today
prompts.text: Name one thing, however small, that helped today.

prompts.title: Day 6: Being kind to myself
prompts.text: What would you say to a friend in your place this week?

prompts.title: Day 7: Looking back on week one
prompts.text: What surprised you this week? What do you want to keep doing?

prompts.title: My evening plan
prompts.text: What will you do in the next hour instead of the old habit?

prompts.title: Tomorrow, one thing

prompts.title: Letting the day go
prompts.text: Finish this sentence: "Today is done. Tonight I can..."
